maddeler.e:
ننفعل (form VII)
# نَنْفَعِلُ (nanfaʕilu) /nan.fa.ʕi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْفَعَلَ (infaʕala)
# نَنْفَعِلَ (nanfaʕila) /nan.fa.ʕi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَعَلَ (infaʕala)
# نَنْفَعِلْ (nanfaʕil) /nan.fa.ʕil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْفَعَلَ (infaʕala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
